0x000878.en: 「I... is this as far as I go...!」

0x0008AA.en: 「With my skills now...@　this is as far as I get...!」

0x00091B.en: 「Guh! @　This is as far as I go...!!」

0x0009A3.en: 「Dammit! @　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A1D.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000B04.en: 「Well now...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000BCD.en: 「Ugh! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000C08.en: 「Like hell I go down here...!@　Not funny...」

0x000C5C.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CD0.en: 「Guh! I've got no choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D46.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000DAD.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DDF.en: 「Dammit...!@　Is this as far as I go!」

0x000E59.en: 「No good, we took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000EA6.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000EE4.en: 「Ah, I'll leave the rest in your hands!」

0x000F2B.en: 「The Granzon... shot down, of all things...」

0x000FD6.en: 「Ugh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x00108D.en: 「Ow, ow, ow... You got me. Bad calculation.」

0x001112.en: 「Gh... nngh! So this is my limit...!」

0x0011C6.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0011FB.en: 「Damn it! Is this all I've got...!」

0x0012B8.en: 「Gh... You're as good as they say.」

0x0012E7.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@ I'm still green...!」

0x001335.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x0013AE.en: 「Sorry!@ I'm gonna have to bow out...!」

0x0013F0.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x00141F.en: 「Ah, no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00145D.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x00148C.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x001517.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x001565.en: 「N, not in a place like this...!」

0x00167D.en: 「I'm bailing out...@ Gh...! Not exactly graceful...」

0x00190B.en: 「A, all hands!@ Abandon ship, priority one...!!」

0x00194D.en: 「No good, I've gone and got myself hit.」

0x0019FD.en: 「So, did we find out where Kirkus went?」

0x001A3A.en: 「We're searching, but no word yet.@ Not all of Kirkus's army has surrendered,@ so the skirmishes will probably drag on a while.」

0x001B06.en: 「Well, as long as Kirkus is alive,@ there'll be guys who'll follow him even@ against orders.」

0x001B9C.en: 「Forget the capital, chaos is everywhere.@ We can't track our units properly...@ and finding the summoned surface-dwellers isn't easy.」

0x001C59.en: 「And on top of that, we've got word that@ Shutedonias special forces slipped back in@ under cover of the confusion.」

0x001CEC.en: 「Those guys still trying to pull something in Langran?」

0x001D35.en: 「There are bound to be stragglers too...@ Odds are high they'll exploit our disorder@ to run sabotage operations.」

0x001DCB.en: 「...By the way, when do we get back to the surface?」

0x001E11.en: 「A little while longer. The clergy who evacuated@ to various regions will return to the capital,@ and with their power they'll open the Gate.」

0x001F62.en: 「M, more to the point, that Ing guy's@ pretty capable, isn't he?@ You gonna put him in on the next op too?」

0x002035.en: 「I saw nothing suspicious in his conduct, but@ to handle a machine he'd never piloted like that...」

0x0020B8.en: 「Aren't there plenty of guys like that in the Steel Dragons?」

0x002154.en: 「A new request came from Prince Feil.@ Shutedonias special forces infiltrated Troia province@ and clashed with the local units.」

0x002205.en: 「Afterward, the enemy seems to have gone to ground near Mt. Grimord.」

0x002270.en: 「If the request came to us, that means...@ the locals couldn't handle it.」

0x002301.en: 「Is there something important to the enemy@ at Mt. Grimord?」

0x002366.en: 「Yes. I hear there are several@ orichalconium mines there.」

0x0023F3.en: 「A special metal produced in <La Gias>.@ This pendant is made of orichalconium too.」

0x0024B6.en: 「Orichalconium is light and strong, and@ it's psychic-responsive too, so it's used@ in Magic Armor plating as well.」

0x002549.en: 「Could it be related to the@ Zol Orichalconium used in the SRX...?」

0x0025B4.en: 「I looked at the data. Seems the SRX uses@ orichalconium sourced from La Gias.」

0x002625.en: 「Maybe Christoph took it@ up to the surface...」

0x00268D.en: （And then... it was provided to the SRX Project...?）

0x0026D9.en: 「Also... down here, it's the fashion to give@ little orichalconium trinkets as a stand-in@ for a marriage proposal.」

0x0027C9.en: 「Whoa!@ Martha, did you propose to somebody?」

0x002832.en: 「Denying it that hard is suspicious~!@ Does Lune know about it?」

0x0028A0.en: 「What, what? I want to hear this too.」

0x0028E0.en: 「Argh!@ This is no time for that kind of talk!」

0x002933.en: 「Right. Cut the chatter, all of you.@ Prince Feil surmises the enemy's aim is@ the low-yield orichalconium, but...」

0x0029E4.en: 「he questions why they'd head for@ Mt. Grimord at this particular@ moment.」

0x002A62.en: 「Is there something there besides@ the orichalconium mines?」

0x002AB8.en: 「Speaking of Mt. Grimord, there's a rumor@ that the god of destruction, Serva Volkruss,@ slumbers there.」

0x002B3F.en: 「A god of destruction... so such a thing exists.」

0x002B7F.en: 「The true nature of Serva Volkruss@ isn't well understood, but...」

0x002BE4.en: 「The leading theory: it's the residual thoughts@ of an ancient super-intellect that died out long ago...@ in other words, a kind of ghost.」

0x002C70.en: 「Though there's also a theory it's a mass of@ residual thoughts from the giant race.」

0x002CAD.en: 「An ultra-ancient civilization and a giant race, huh.@ Well, this is a world where spirits are real...」

0x002D12.en: 「As a suspicious old presence, isn't it@ a bit like the <Einst>?」

0x002DC5.en: 「But like Louzorl, there are believers who@ worship Volkruss as a god. And now the@ Barrier of Harmony is gone, too...」

0x002E82.en: 「It wouldn't be strange for there to be@ a move to revive the evil god.」

0x002EE4.en: 「And Shutedonias might be tangled up in it.@ This is way past the point of just@ smelling fishy.」

0x002F8C.en: 「Praying to an evil god instead of a real one?@ Anyway, is Volkruss even something@ a human could control?」

0x003025.en: 「I doubt it.@ Which means Shutedonias's side has@ a big downside too.」

0x003097.en: 「And how do you even@ revive Volkruss in the first place?」

0x003115.en: 「...Don't tell me there's a temple to@ Volkruss somewhere on Mt. Grimord?」

0x00319B.en: 「When my brother once ordered a survey@ into Volkruss-related matters, it did come@ up as a subject, but...」

0x00322B.en: 「The pre-construction survey found no mention@ of ruins or a temple... and with all that's@ happened, we haven't done a detailed check.」

0x0032E8.en: 「Then we've got no choice but to go check.」

0x00331F.en: 「Right. We now head for Mt. Grimord.@ Departure time, 1400. All hands, to your posts.」

0x0033A8.en: Holy Langran Kingdom - Troia Province - Mt. Grimord

0x00340E.en: 「...5000 to the first Mt. Grimord mine.@ No enemy contacts in the vicinity.」

0x003479.en: 「Put the mine footage on the main screen.」

0x0034C6.en: 「...Looks like there was a battle here.」

0x003500.en: 「Yes...@ And there are traces of several machines that@ look like Magic Armor entering the cave.」

0x00357E.en: 「We hit the jackpot right off. The ship will@ hold TD hover at the cave mouth. Tell all@ units to launch and scout the interior.」

0x00361B.en: 「The enemy is likely lying in wait inside.@ Maintain strict ground vigilance.」

0x003680.en: 「Wide cave, huh. Magic Armor could pass through easy.」

0x0036BA.en: 「They made it big so the mining machinery@ could move in and out.」

0x003713.en: 「But this mine was abandoned after a@ major cave-in accident.@ Meaning the enemy's aim isn't orichalconium...」

0x0037C1.en: 「Those Shutedonias bastards... are they seriously@ thinking of doing something with@ Volkruss...!?」

0x003855.en: 「...Lady Tytti, this is strange.@ The spirits have vanished completely from this cave.」

0x003914.en: 「I, I feel sick... What is this place...?」

0x0039AE.en: 「If he's here, then...@ this really is where Volkruss's temple is!?」

0x003A59.en: 「You... don't tell me you mean to@ give Volkruss physical form here!?」

0x003ABE.en: 「Precisely.@ Though, to be exact, it's one of Lord@ Volkruss's avatars...」

0x003B36.en: 「Do you understand what that will bring about!?」

0x003B82.en: 「Have you forgotten my epithet?@ Demon Priest - that is, the dark cleric@ who serves Lord Volkruss.」

0x003C0C.en: 「A mere avatar, perhaps, but I've made a pact with Lord Volkruss.@　Bending its power to my will is@　child's play...」

0x003CAE.en: 「With that power, I'll plunge this land into chaos once more...@　That is my aim.」

0x003D4B.en: (The pulse I felt the other day has grown stronger.@　Though it seems it won't be of any use@　in reviving Lord Volkruss...)

0x003DE7.en: 「Don't you move a muscle, you bastard!@　I'm gonna take you down right now!」

0x003E43.en: 「Short-tempered as ever, I see.@　You lot can stay here and play a while.」

0x003EAB.en: 「So those are the Shutedonias special forces.」

0x003EEB.en: 「Louzorl, so you were in league with them!」

0x003F34.en: 「Well then, I'll take my leave here.@　Major Kanzort Jog, I leave the rest to you.」

0x003FC1.en: 「I told you not to use my full name!」

0x004054.en: 「Hold it. I'm the one you're dealing with.@　You're not going a step further.」

0x0040B9.en: 「Stop this, all of you!@　Do you have any idea what reviving Volkruss@　will bring about!?」

0x004143.en: 「Yeah. Langran falls, and our nation@　stops being threatened.@　Sounds fine to me.」

0x0041C1.en: 「You're being deceived!@　You really think Louzorl can be trusted!?」

0x004235.en: 「You're gonna spout the same line as him?@　This is no time to be picky about methods.」

0x0042A6.en: 「One wrong move and@　Shutedonias won't come out of this unscathed either!」

0x0042FF.en: 「All we need is Langran in chaos, for now.@　All units, commence the attack.」

0x004412.en: 「That was a hassle!@　Let's hurry to the shrine deeper in!」

0x0044AC.en: 「Good grief. I'd hoped Major Jog would@　buy me a little more time...」

0x004523.en: 「Now that you've come this far, there's no help for it.@　I'll break the seal at once.」

0x0045C2.en: 「Ah yes, let me tell you one thing.@　Earlier I claimed I could control@　Lord Volkruss. That was a lie.」

0x004698.en: 「It's a pretext to get Shutedonias and you surface-dwellers to help.@ Once Volkruss wakes, he'll unleash nothing but destruction.」

0x00476B.en: 「The avatar of Lord Volkruss about to manifest@　has no intellect. It will act on@　destructive impulse alone.」

0x00480A.en: 「You're saying you'll revive something@ that's far beyond control!?」

0x004860.en: 「Death alone is equal to all things.@　Receive this supreme, absolute truth.」

0x0048D1.en: 「You're saying your goal is to destroy everything?」

0x00490B.en: 「...Well then, I'll leave Lord Volkruss's avatar@　to you to deal with...@　and take my leave around here.」

0x0049C2.en: 「My god's avatars still slumber@　in many other lands, you see...@　Truly, I'm a busy man.」

0x004A46.en: 「He's leaving the avatar behind and running...!!」

0x004A83.en: 「Once he's made Volkruss's avatar real,@　nothing else matters to him...!?」

0x004AF7.en: 「He's already achieved his goal of breaking the seal.@　The avatar appearing may just be one@　side effect that came with it.」

0x004BE2.en: 「You said the same thing earlier.@　Why is that?」

0x004C51.en: 「Ngh...!@　A powerful negative force... is gathering...!」

0x004CF4.en: 「Now that's the face of an evil god, all right.」

0x004D28.en: 「No kidding.@　If something cute came out here, I'd be more shocked.」

0x004D81.en: 「If that thing gets outside the shrine, it's disaster!@　We've got no choice but to finish it here!」

0x004E04.en: 「B-but can we even beat something like that!?」

0x004E3B.en: 「We've got three Elemental Lords on our side.@　We've got a shot!」

0x004EBC.en: 「Momentum alone won't cut it, fight carefully.@　If we lose even a bit of strength here,@　it could lead to defeat.」

0x004F55.en: 「Don't get shot down, is that it? I know!」

0x004F98.en: 「Objects resembling Elemental Machines have entered the shrine! Two of them!」

0x004FDE.en: 「Could it be that special forces unit!?」

0x00503D.en: 「Those guys don't know when to quit!」

0x005068.en: 「So that's Volkruss, eh!@　And where's Louzorl run off to!?」

0x0050FB.en: 「The one with the Troia accent from before...」

0x00512C.en: 「Oi, Masaki Andoh. Can you hear me?@　It's me, Rodney Jesuha.@　I'll help you take down Volkruss.」

0x005206.en: 「I'm no general anymore.@　Got demoted, made colonel and all.」

0x00526E.en: 「Don't try to gloss over this! They're the enemy!」

0x0052B7.en: 「Idiot!@　If we don't deal with that monster, it won't just be us,@　the whole homeland's in for it.」

0x00533B.en: 「That's why I told Jog to quit@　teaming up with Louzorl.@　Sure enough, the guy's turned tail and bolted.」

0x0053E6.en: 「Besides, this Troia is my birthplace.@　So that's how it is, I'm helping them out.」

0x00546C.en: 「...Understood.@　My judgment was lacking. My apologies.」

0x0054D4.en: 「Glad you get it.@　So then, Masaki Andoh...@　a temporary ceasefire, that all right?」

0x0055C1.en: 「Not yet.@　We've gotta seal this place up.@　Tytti, I'm counting on you.」

0x005621.en: 「Got it.@　Gaddess, sealing mode... Plana index, 7.8.@　High-speed incantation release.」

0x005699.en: 「Seal complete.@　I used Gragios's seal-crest, so@　even Louzorl can't lay a hand on it.」

0x005717.en: 「Well, that's that settled.@　Right then, we'll be taking our leave.」

0x005770.en: 「Next time we meet, we'll be enemies.@　Makes it a bit awkward, though.」

0x005822.en: 「Master Masaki, is it all right to let them go?」

0x00585F.en: 「Yeah, the old geezers helped us out.@　Besides, I'll pass on another fight right now.」

0x005953.en: 「Ha! You take care too, kid! See ya!」

0x005993.en: 「...Kind of a hard guy to hate, huh.」

0x0059C7.en: 「Yeah...@　No matter their character, they're forced to fight@　for their nation's sake... It's a sad thing.」

0x005A39.en: 「Anyway, we need to contact my brother@　and get security here beefed up.」

0x005A9E.en: 「Yeah.@　And... don't you even think about@　trying to take a piece of Volkruss home.」

0x005B32.en: 「Nailed it, huh!@　With things like that, if even a few cells are left,@　they always come back to life!」

0x005BF3.en: 「F-fine, I get it.@　I just thought it might be a clue to figuring out@　what Volkruss really is...」

0x005C77.en: 「To be safe, we should torch this whole area@　with napalm or something.」

0x005CE2.en: 「Then I'll do it.@　I'll wipe out every last piece@　clean with Cyflash.」

0x005D51.en: 「Getting yourselves used by the likes of Louzorl!」

0x005D8E.en: 「Hmph, we're the ones using him!@　To crush Langran!」

0x005DF3.en: 「If Volkruss revives,@　countless lives will be lost!」

0x005E49.en: 「Like I care how many Langran people die!」

0x005E92.en: 「Trying to use an evil god, that's pretty cheap, isn't it!?」

0x005ED5.en: 「Say what you like!@　We're just carrying out our orders!」

0x005F2B.en: 「That monster's supposed to be a god!?@　You've gotta be out of your minds!」

0x005F81.en: 「That's less a god than a giant of Jotunheim...@　Hideous.」

0x005FDD.en: 「Ugh, so gross! We've gotta clean it up quick!」

0x006029.en: 「Can't leave a monster like that running loose!@　Here goes!」

0x00607C.en: 「Volkruss...@　That ominous monstrosity is supposed to be a god!」

0x0060D2.en: 「A super-ancient civilization, the residual thoughts of a giant race...@　We'll need to dig into just how much@　of that is true.」

0x00615F.en: 「Ugh, we have to fight that thing...?@　It's so gross...」

0x0061B2.en: 「All right, let's slay the demon and rescue the princess!@　If there is one, that is.」

0x006214.en: 「Well, monsters like that come with this kind of world.」

0x00625D.en: 「So in this world, it's only natural@　something like that would exist...!」

0x0062D2.en: 「...If that was an avatar,@　then where's the real Volkruss?」

0x00633A.en: 「Who knows... We'll just have to investigate from here.」

0x006377.en: 「Judging by what Louzorl said,@　Volkruss avatars are likely to appear in other places too.」

0x0063F4.en: 「If that bastard Shu has a hand in this...@　No, I can't believe he's got nothing to do with it.」

0x006468.en: 「Then aren't Princess Monica and Prince Terius in danger?」

0x0064B7.en: 「I worry about those two, but we know too little.@ Tracking down Kristof and the others will have to wait@ until Langran settles down...」

0x006586.en: (Shu...@　where the hell are you, and what are you up to...?)
